description:
=== DONE (s473t5c) ===

FOUND s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 1) as the cause of t/comp/proto.t's
single aborted top-level form, `Undefined subroutine &main::1 called`.

TWO SITES, ONE RULE.  `\` over a `&`-MENTION is the SUB SLOT, never a call.
`\&foo` had the intercept (`Pl::ExprToCL::gen_prefix_op_form`); the
PARENTHESISED spelling did not, so `\(&foo)` lowered its element through the
ordinary `&`-prefix CALL path -- `(p-backslash (pl-foo @_))` -- which calls foo
with the caller's @_ and takes a reference to the RESULT.  And the prototype
ref-slot table in `gen_funcall_form` handled `\@`, `\%`, `\$` and not `\&`, so
`f(&NAME)` under a `(\&)` prototype ran the sub too.

  PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl), BEFORE:
    \(&foo)        perl CODE, no call   PCL SCALAR, called foo
    \(&foo, &bar)  perl CODE,CODE       PCL SCALAR,SCALAR, called both
    \(&foo, $x)    perl CODE,SCALAR     PCL SCALAR,SCALAR, called foo
    \(&$cr)        perl CODE            PCL SCALAR, called
    \(&{$cr})      perl CODE            PCL SCALAR, called
    sub g (\&); g(&foo)   perl CODE     PCL called foo, arg = 1
  and the INVERSE, right on both trees: `\(&foo())` is a SCALAR ref to the
  call's value.  ARGUMENT PARENS are perl's own discriminator.

t/comp/proto.t's line 291 is `a_sub \(&tmp_sub_1);` with `sub a_sub (&) { ...
&{$_[0]} }`: tmp_sub_1 ran (printing the file's `ok 61`), a_sub received a
SCALAR ref whose referent held printf's return 1, and `&{$_[0]}` symbolically
called the sub named "1".  That died inside the giant `(p-let ((@array ...)) ...)`
form the file's first top-level `my @array` opens -- i.e. everything after it.

FIX: one reading, `Pl::ExprToCL::_backslash_amp_ref_form`, extracted from the
bare-`\&` intercept and called from FOUR sites: the bare operand, the
one-element `\(&foo)`, every element of `_gen_backslash_multi_term_form`, and
the `\&` prototype slot.  Both mention spellings answer there (`&NAME` as one
`PPI::Token::Symbol`, `&$cr`/`&{EXPR}` as a `&`-Cast prefix_op via
`_amp_cast_operand_id`); anything else returns undef and falls through, which
is what keeps `\(&foo())` a call.

MEASURED: t/comp/proto.t DIFF 47/14 -> **78/38** (61 -> 116 of 216 rows
produced), shortfall 155 -> 100, 28 blessed fail rows FIXED.  The remaining
100 are a SECOND abort with a different cause, filed as #1682.
corpus-diff vs 17d831fe IDENTICAL over 111 files (no corpus file has the
shape), emission-ab over lib/**.pm 27 SAME / 0 DIFF / 0 RCDIFF -- so no
generation bump.  Guard `Pl/t/backslash-amp-01.t`, 14 rows, all 14 FAILING on
a `git archive 17d831fe` extraction (which reproduces the `&main::1` abort);
every expectation byte-identical to perl 5.40.3 running the same program.
subject: `\(&NAME)` CALLED the sub and referenced the result, and a `(\&)` prototype slot did the same -- t/comp/proto.t lost 155 rows to one `&main::1` abort
